# ClearPoint Strategy

> ClearPoint Strategy is a cloud-based strategy execution platform that helps organizations align goals, track KPIs, and execute plans through AI-powered dashboards and reporting tools.

ClearPoint Strategy serves enterprises, government agencies, healthcare systems, and educational institutions with comprehensive strategy execution software. The platform leverages AI assistants, real-time dashboards, and automated reporting to reduce planning cycles and improve organizational alignment across complex, multi-departmental operations.
